# 8 Seconds

> The hub built by a rodeo family, for rodeo families. 8 Seconds brings youth
> rodeo into one place: every event, every qualifying ladder, every horse, and
> every arena worth fighting for — with deadline alerts so families never miss a
> draw. Mobile-first, women and girls at the center, and the horse treated as a
> first-class athlete.

## What it does
- **The Draw** (/app/draw): a unified youth-rodeo event feed across associations,
  with filters, entry-deadline countdowns, one-tap entry, and a trip-planning map.
- **The Buckle Board** (/app/buckle): per-contestant qualifying ladders, points,
  stages, and deadlines toward district/state finals.
- **The Tack Room** (/app/tack): family + horse profiles, farrier/vet reminders,
  and a run log — the horse tracked like the athlete it is.
- **The Sponsor Pen** (/app/sponsor): a shareable media kit, sponsor tiers, and
  deliverable tracking for young athletes building a brand.
- **The Gatepost** (/app/gatepost): arena-preservation advocacy — an endangered
  map, petitions, and community organizing to keep local arenas open.
- **Import (AI)** (/app/import): paste results in any format and AI turns them
  into clean rodeo records.

## Plans
- **Free** — the Draw feed, the Gatepost, and a basic horse profile.
- **Arena Family** — $79/year — unlimited kids + horses, Buckle Board, Tack Room
  reminders, and a season budget tracker.
- **Arena Pro** — $19.99/month — everything in Family plus the Sponsor Pen
  toolkit, a media-kit generator, and sponsor recap reports.
- **Associations** — from $49/month — event management, member database, and draw
  tools for youth-rodeo associations.
